description: OMENZ Authorize: the authorization step for agent payments. One call before paying any x402 endpoint: live quote + preflight (up, price within max, network, stablecoin, expected payTo), payee check (known x402 seller?) + OFAC sanctions screen (a sanctioned payTo = DECLINE) + seller domain age (registered < 30 days = REVIEW) + x402 payout proof (domain's DNS/well-known record excludes this payTo = DECLINE), fair-price check vs comparable endpoints, the owner's spend policy and Permission Passport if sent -> APPROVE / REVIEW / DECLINE with reasons and a signed 5-minute authorization code anyone can verify. Never pays the target. Doing many? Prepay once (POST /v1/credits/buy-1, $1) and check via /v1/authorize/credit at 2% of the payment (min $0.0003), with no per-check settlement. By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: POST https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/authorize, $0.002 via x402.)

expected_pay_to.description: payout wallet you expect (0x...), to catch swapped payees

max_price_usd.description: most you are willing to pay per call, in USD

method.description: HTTP method of the target endpoint (GET or POST)

spend.description: what you have spent so far, e.g. {"spent_today_usd": 1.2}
